items.stem:
Read the following extract on feudalism in medieval Europe and answer the questions that follow.
"In the feudal system the lord gave protection and land, and the vassal gave loyalty and service. In feudal society, agricultural production was organised around the lord's manor. The Normans under Duke William conquered England in 1066, and he distributed land among his followers."
(i) Before the Franks, the region that became France was a Roman province called: (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'manor' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: William of Normandy could reward his followers after 1066. (2)
items.answer: (i) Gaul (ii) The estate of a lord, consisting of his mansion, the villages, fields, meadows and forests worked by peasants. (iii) He controlled the land of England and distributed it among his knights and nobles.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) Gaul (ii) The estate of a lord, consisting of his mansion, the villages, fields, meadows and forests worked by peasants. (iii) He controlled the land of England and distributed it among his knights and nobles.
